execution: EVIDENCE MATRIX; NO NEW PROVIDER ACCEPTANCE EXECUTED

priorFormalMatrix.note: Earlier formal matrix predates later staging identity/proactive-refresh receipts; neither proves uploads/schedules.

statusRules.VERIFIED: Only cited prior-source subset, with explicit historical environment/version limit; not current public launch acceptance.
statusRules.IMPLEMENTED BUT UNVERIFIED: Code or synthetic validation exists; no real provider receipt.
statusRules.SUBMITTED / AWAITING GOOGLE: Use only after actual provider submission confirmation; no cases currently assigned.
statusRules.UNSUPPORTED: Dedicated Shorts upload endpoint, arbitrary third-party channel destination and unsupported API features must not be claimed.

cases.scenario: Read-only connection and immutable YouTube Channel ID
cases.requiredEvidence: Actual consent, encrypted credential metadata and channels.list identity readback.
cases.remainingGate: Prior staging source only; current production client not configured. Legacy refresh migration requires one reconnect.

cases.scenario: Read-only identity and permission revalidation
cases.requiredEvidence: Provider identity/scope observation matched channel and stored grant.
cases.remainingGate: Prior staging source only; not current release acceptance.

cases.scenario: Refresh a still-valid staging token within its refresh margin
cases.requiredEvidence: Expiry advanced and real channel/video read succeeded after proactive refresh.
cases.remainingGate: Prior raw legacy custody cannot prove refresh issuer in new v2 release; not expired-token acceptance.

cases.scenario: Completely new eligible public Google account connects without tester enrollment
cases.requiredEvidence: Verified production standard client, approved required scopes and independent non-tester consent.
cases.remainingGate: Production OAuth/Google verification not configured or approved; independent holder consent absent.

cases.scenario: Existing read-only user upgrades to upload/manage grants
cases.requiredEvidence: New incremental Google consent and actual granted scopes, unchanged exact channel/lane.
cases.remainingGate: Write-scope account consent not supplied; no creator grant.

cases.scenario: Multiple genuinely independent Google accounts connect
cases.requiredEvidence: At least two independently consented holders, distinct credential custody and tenant identities.
cases.remainingGate: Independent account-holder consent/access absent; single-owner historical connection is insufficient.

cases.scenario: Multiple channels and both OAuth lanes retain immutable identities
cases.requiredEvidence: Separate channel identities/connections; exact provider token validates destination and lane.
cases.remainingGate: Real multiple-channel and dual-client consent absent.

cases.scenario: Expired bound v2 standard and agentic tokens refresh
cases.requiredEvidence: Real exact-client refresh after expiry; identity and scopes retained, no raw-token export.
cases.remainingGate: No real v2 production standard/agentic grant.

cases.scenario: Revoked grant requires reconnect and purges affected authorized data
cases.requiredEvidence: Owner revocation, provider invalid_grant/401, exact-grant fenced purge and user reconnect result.
cases.remainingGate: Owner-specific revoke/consent action absent; no new real execution.

cases.scenario: Approved disposable video uploads privately
cases.requiredEvidence: Official resumable session, immutable Video ID and verified private status.
cases.remainingGate: Account write consent and exact disposable approved asset missing.

cases.scenario: YouTube confirms uploaded video processing
cases.requiredEvidence: Provider videos.list processing succeeded and expected private status.
cases.remainingGate: No real upload resource.

cases.scenario: Eligible Short uploads through official video API
cases.requiredEvidence: Provider upload/processing plus actual YouTube classification if observable; no dedicated Shorts endpoint claim.
cases.remainingGate: No approved Shorts asset or creator grant; classification remains provider controlled.

cases.scenario: Private never-published video gets a future native schedule
cases.requiredEvidence: Provider private status and exact future publishAt readback; authorized eventual visibility.
cases.remainingGate: No write grant/resource; public eligibility and affected-owner publication consent absent.

cases.scenario: Change a native scheduled publication time
cases.requiredEvidence: New future publishAt verified in provider status.
cases.remainingGate: No authorized scheduled resource.

cases.scenario: Cancel a pending native scheduled publication
cases.requiredEvidence: Provider private status, publishAt removed; no delete.
cases.remainingGate: No authorized scheduled resource.

cases.scenario: Queue upload itself for later execution
cases.requiredEvidence: Worker waits until upload time, then resumable execution; actual provider schedule separately verified.
cases.remainingGate: No approved queued asset/write grant or provider execution.

cases.scenario: Expired or DST-invalid schedule never publishes immediately
cases.requiredEvidence: Validation receipts plus provider absence of unintended immediate publication.
cases.remainingGate: Synthetic guards implemented; real provider-backed negative acceptance absent.

cases.scenario: Publication result matches actual YouTube visibility
cases.requiredEvidence: Provider Video ID status readback including processing and visibility, distinct scheduled vs published receipt.
cases.remainingGate: No provider-backed uploaded/scheduled/published resource.

cases.scenario: Update authorized video metadata
cases.requiredEvidence: Exact approved fields and videos.list readback.
cases.remainingGate: No approved resource/write consent.

cases.scenario: Set an authorized thumbnail
cases.requiredEvidence: Approved image, thumbnails.set and provider readback/visual acceptance.
cases.remainingGate: No approved disposable upload/thumbnail resource; prior thumbnail deployment is code/UI evidence only.

cases.scenario: Manage authorized captions and playlists
cases.requiredEvidence: Exact approved official method execution and owned resource readback.
cases.remainingGate: No consented disposable tracks/playlists; destructive operations require specific resource approval.

cases.scenario: Read/respond/moderate supported authorized comments
cases.requiredEvidence: Real scoped resource/ownership checks and exact approved action readback.
cases.remainingGate: No separately approved comment/resource action; moderation not assumed.

cases.scenario: Read available nonmonetary channel/video Analytics
cases.requiredEvidence: Real authorized reports.query response with source/date/range; no fabricated or revenue metrics.
cases.remainingGate: No new Analytics scope consent or provider acceptance.

cases.scenario: Interrupted or failed uploads do not duplicate videos
cases.requiredEvidence: Fault-controlled resumable journal recovery and actual same-session/Video ID provider state.
cases.remainingGate: Synthetic guards exist; real disposable upload failure/recovery not executed.

cases.scenario: Concurrent users cannot read or publish to another tenant channel
cases.requiredEvidence: Independent accounts, denied cross-tenant cases and provider destination proof.
cases.remainingGate: Independent provider accounts absent; SQL/synthetic tests cannot replace this scenario.

cases.scenario: Workers recover interrupted approved jobs
cases.requiredEvidence: Controlled crash/restart with same journal and verified provider outcome.
cases.remainingGate: No disposable provider upload or authorized failure injection.

cases.scenario: Quota exhaustion delays safely and fairly
cases.requiredEvidence: Actual project quota observation and bounded controlled denial with no duplicate/provider leak.
cases.remainingGate: Production allocations/usage uninspected; do not exhaust a live project just to test.

cases.scenario: Desktop/mobile creator flow works against real grants
cases.requiredEvidence: Browser/device results for consent, draft, upload, receipts and calendar on running release.
cases.remainingGate: Creator flow provider prerequisites absent; local synthetic views are distinct.

cases.scenario: Every manual publication requires exact approval
cases.requiredEvidence: Rejected unapproved operations; approved exact resource/time executed with provider result.
cases.remainingGate: Code implemented; no real upload/schedule acceptance.

cases.scenario: Bounded authorized Autopilot publishes covered content
cases.requiredEvidence: Owner policy, separate actual agentic grant, allowed source/channel/time/limits, actual receipt and pause/revoke behavior.
cases.remainingGate: Agentic client not configured/designated/verified; owner policy/asset consent and provider execution absent.

cases.scenario: Explicitly authorized public test publication after eligibility
cases.requiredEvidence: Google/project eligibility evidence plus separate affected-owner exact publication consent and provider public status.
cases.remainingGate: Public eligibility unverified; specific public-publication consent absent.

cases.scenario: 10,000-account load, fairness and reliability
cases.requiredEvidence: Cloud load/reliability and SQL tenant isolation evidence on release source; capacity model reconciled to approved quota.
cases.remainingGate: Cloud CI/release load evidence pending; no claim of 10,000 real connected accounts.

cases.scenario: Large-video upload beyond 50 MB through scalable private storage
cases.requiredEvidence: Approved storage plan/global and bucket limits plus actual large private upload/resume/readback on released source.
cases.remainingGate: Supabase organization verified Free; private postriff-video bucket limit 50000000 bytes and Free global limit 50 MB. Owner billing question pending; no plan change or checkout performed.
